topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 89 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 9 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 11 common project-authored base contract(s) (basemath, operator, stakingrewardschild). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
